{{Term/Store|Woodland Boar|Woodland Boars|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Woodland Boar'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Woodland Boar'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Woodland Boar}}
Woodland Boars are stocky species of [[Boar]], and they are known to be found all throughout [[Hyrule]].<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|These medium-sized beasts can be found all throughout Hyrule. You can most often find them foraging for food in forests or meadows. Although usually docile, they won't hesitate to charge you full force if you get too close.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> They are most common in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Lanayru Great Spring]], though they are notably the only large animals found on the [[Great Plateau]]. Oftentimes, they forage for food in forests or meadows.<ref name="Compendium"/>

Though uncommon, startled Woodland Boars may charge at [[Link]] in defense if they detect him.<ref name="Compendium"/> This does not happen if [[Link]] is riding a [[Horse]]. However, Woodland Boars are more likely to flee if disturbed. When slain, Woodland Boars produce between one and two pieces of [[Raw Meat]]. [[Bokoblin]]s will chase after Woodland Boars that wander near their [[Monster Stronghold]]s, with the purpose of killing and eating them.

==Trivia==
* Both Woodland Boars and [[Red-Tusked Boar]]s closely resemble {{wp|wild boar}}s, a species of large, tusked pigs native to the forests of {{wp|Eurasia}} and parts of {{wp|North Africa}}.
